abi.argument_count.note: The remote wrapper supplies ten arguments; workspace is not an argument.

abi.argument_order.note: Argument names and order are fixed.

abi.output_semantics.value: write supplied out tensor in place; no returned tensor

abi.formal_kernel.value: RoutedMoEKernel eleven-tensor call including caller workspace
abi.formal_kernel.note: This is the local formal research ABI, not the remote ABI.
abi.formal_kernel.close_with: Only an explicit remote platform statement could make the formal ABI remotely applicable.

workload.case_order.note: Display order of the three published cases.

tensor.routed_expert_weights.shape.note: One route weight per compact row.

tensor.data_dtype.note: Input, weights, route weights, private workspace and output are FP16 in the published table.

tensor.stride_requirements.note: The available table gives shapes and dtypes but no stride contract.
tensor.stride_requirements.close_with: Obtain testcase_config.py or a remote tensor metadata dump containing shape, stride and contiguity for every argument.

tensor.contiguity_requirements.note: Local fixtures allocate contiguous tensors, but remote contiguity is not stated.
tensor.contiguity_requirements.close_with: Obtain an authoritative remote wrapper assertion or tensor metadata dump.

storage.workspace_rows.note: A valid private intermediate needs one compact row per input route; the remote wrapper does not pass it.
storage.workspace_rows.close_with: A remote wrapper/source dump would promote this derivation.

workspace.policy.note: The ten-argument ABI implies no supplied workspace, but allocation, reuse and cache policy are private to the submission/evaluator interaction.
workspace.policy.close_with: Obtain the exact remote wrapper lifecycle or a platform statement about permitted private allocation and caching.

metadata.group_sizes.length.close_with: Remote tensor metadata would promote this derivation.

metadata.group_offsets.formula.note: Compact row starts used by the cited benchmark.

metadata.group_padded_offsets.formula.note: Current cited-source derivation; it is not independently observed in the private evaluator.
metadata.group_padded_offsets.formula.close_with: Obtain remote testcase_config.py or hashes of its metadata tensors.

metadata.block_count.formula.close_with: Obtain remote testcase_config.py or a remote group_idx_for_bx length dump.

metadata.group_idx_for_bx.formula.close_with: Obtain remote testcase_config.py or raw metadata hashes.

routing.group_sizes_generation.note: The private routing generator and RNG sequence are unavailable.

routing.assignment_distribution.note: Published dimensions do not establish uniform, top-k, balanced or model-derived routing.
routing.assignment_distribution.close_with: Obtain the remote routing algorithm and seed or the exact group_sizes arrays.

routing.route_weight_generation.close_with: Obtain the remote route-weight generator, seed and distribution.
